blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala didn’t want to leave anything to chance ahead of her Singapore Open main draw debut. Eala still found time to work on her game Thursday in an open practice session at Court 1, just hours before her round-of-16 match against Russian Tatiana Prozorova.
